name: Near Vision
definition: The ability to see details at close range (within a few feet of the observer).

benchmark.name: MVTec AD
benchmark.metric: Mean image-level AUROC (%) across the 15 MVTec AD categories
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant workforce: industrial visual inspectors and quality-control workers with normal near vision who judge close-up product images for defects (median inspector, not an expert metrologist).

benchmark.name: MVTec AD
benchmark.metric: mean image-level AUROC (%) across 15 MVTec AD categories
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant specialist workforce: industrial visual quality inspectors examining close-up product images for surface and structural defects

benchmark.name: DocVQA
benchmark.metric: ANLS (Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity) on the DocVQA test set, rescaled from 0–1 to 0–100 (0.8841 on the leaderboard)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce with normal corrected near vision who read scanned documents such as forms, tables and letters at work (office and clerical workers)

benchmark.name: V*Bench
benchmark.model_or_system: SEAL (LLaVA-7B-based MLLM with the V* LLM-guided visual search module)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce with normal or corrected-to-normal near vision, inspecting high-resolution images for small object details

benchmark.name: V* Bench
benchmark.model_or_system: SEAL (V* guided visual search + Vicuna-7B MLLM)
benchmark.human_reference: General adults with normal or corrected near vision, viewing the full-resolution image on a screen and free to zoom and pan.

benchmark.name: HR-Bench
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce with normal or corrected-to-normal vision, inspecting high-resolution images on a screen with ordinary zoom/pan ability (the relevant population for close-range detail inspection)

benchmark.name: HR-Bench
benchmark.human_reference: General adult / educated workforce inspecting high-resolution images on a screen with the ability to zoom. This is the typical person who reads fine print, small markings and small object attributes as part of work.
